title: CBIC Invites Feedback on Draft Warehousing Operations Regulations, 2026
content:
# CBIC Invites Feedback on Draft Warehousing Operations Regulations, 2026

Ek important update hai. The Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) ne Draft Warehousing Operations Regulations, 2026 ke liye stakeholder consultation process initiate kiya hai.

Here are the key details:
*   **Advisory Details:** This consultation process has been initiated as per F. No. 473/12/2026-LC dated September 21, 2026.
*   **Purpose:** CBIC ne stakeholders se is draft regulations par comments, views, ya suggestions invite kiye hain.
*   **Submission Deadline:** Stakeholders ko apne feedback letter issue hone ki date (September 21, 2026) se 15 din ke andar submit karna hoga.
*   **How to Submit:** Draft regulations CBIC website par public consultation ke liye upload ho chuke hain. Stakeholders ko apna feedback prescribed format mein, electronically submit karna hoga.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Visit the CBIC Homepage for updates](https://www.cbic.gov.in)

*Published on: 22 September 2026*
